morphology.pattern_note: 单音节拟声词，末尾 /s/ 须发出。此爆裂声义没有适合列作常用派生词的词族；不将同形异义词混入词族。

senses.zh_definition: “啪”“砰”一类爆裂声的拟声名称，尤指鞭炮、火炮或枪支发出的声响。
senses.en_definition: An imitative word for a sharp explosive report, such as that of a firecracker or gun.
senses.ms_definition: Bunyi seperti bunyi letupan mercun, meriam atau senapang.
senses.nuances: 本条依输入释义处理爆裂声义，词性按所指的声响归为名词；独立出现时也可作拟声表达。实际交谈中更常说 bunyi mercun 或 bunyi letupan，不能把 tas 当作各种响声的通称。DBP 另列带 IB 标记的“包、袋”义及带 ark sl 标记的“迅速”义，均须与本义区分。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=tas)

dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam keterangannya, saksi menggambarkan bunyi letupan itu sebagai bunyi 'tas' yang kuat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 证人在陈述中形容，那次爆裂发出了响亮的“啪”的一声。
dual_scenarios.en: In the witness statement, the sound of the explosion was described as a loud, sharp bang.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tadi ada bunyi 'tas' kat luar, kau dengar tak?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Tadi ada bunyi 'tas' di luar. Adakah kamu mendengarnya?
dual_scenarios.zh: 刚才外面啪了一声，你听到了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: There was a sharp bang outside just now. Did you hear it?
spoken_features: kat 对应标准语 di，表示地点。
kau 是熟人之间使用的第二人称代词。
句末 tak 构成口语是非问句。
tas 在此直接模拟声响，而非表示“包”。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tadi ada bunyi 'tas' kat luar, kau dengar tak?
messages.ms_standard: Tadi ada bunyi 'tas' di luar. Adakah kamu mendengarnya?
messages.zh: 刚才外面啪了一声，你听到了吗？
messages.en: There was a sharp bang outside just now. Did you hear it?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_standard: Saya mendengarnya. Mungkin itu hanya bunyi mercun.
messages.zh: 听到了。大概只是鞭炮声吧。

etymology.historical_story: The packet identifies tas as a word imitating an explosive sound. Its brief shape makes it useful for representing a sudden report in storytelling. DBP also records a bag sense and an archaic sense meaning quickly, but lists them separately. Keeping these meanings apart prevents a sound word from acquiring an invented history based on an unrelated homograph. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=tas)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tas 的短促读音配上“啪！”的画面：一声爆响，一个音节；最后的 s 也要读出来。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 拟声词本身没有敬语差别。向长辈或主管叙述时，用 terdengar bunyi letupan 等完整表达通常更清楚。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合故事、对话及声音描写。正式报告宜说明声源是否已确认；听到一声 tas，并不等于能够断定那是枪声。
